{{Top|leg}} 
A '''game fowl''' was a type of edible [[Bird/Legends|bird]] that could be [[Death/Legends|killed]] for food. It was considered a potential source of food for troops.<ref name="MK">''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]''</ref>
